Home News Arts and Culture Business Sports Opinion Research Live TV/Radio Media Elections Dark Mode Dark mode --> Economy Ibrahim Mahama inducted into ECOWAS Business Council, commits to sharing experiences with other countries Source : Joy Business 27 November 2026 11:32pm ▶ Listen to this article Audio By Carbonatix
Engineers & Planners Founder and Chief Executive Officer, Ibrahim Mahama, has been inducted as Ghana’s representative on the ECOWAS Business Council at an event held in Lagos, Nigeria, today, November 27, 2026.
The ceremony brought together leading business personalities and private sector representatives from across the ECOWAS region to advance discussions on regional economic cooperation and private sector development.
Mr Mahama is expected to leverage his extensive experience in the private sector to contribute to regional economic development while sharing Ghana’s business, industrialisation and investment experiences with other ECOWAS member states.
Commenting, the Chairman of the ECOWAS Business Council, Aliko Dangote, said, Mr. Mahama's invitation reflects the confidence placed in your experience, judgement and leadership, and your capacity to represent the interests and perspectives of the private sector in your country, while contributing to the broader regional agenda of the Council.
"I look forward to the privilege of working worth you in establishing a world-class institution that will help shape the future of the regional economic integration, industrial transformation and private sector development within the ECOWAS community", he added.
The 15-member Council, chaired by Dangote Group CEO Aliko Dangote, seeks to promote regional investment, industrialisation, trade and greater private sector participation in West Africa’s economic integration.
